rationale: The agent modified the order and issued a gift card refund without first confirming the change with the user, violating the policy to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. It also did not first check or communicate the shipping status or attempt a cancellation as the user requested conditionally. The agent did not provide an arrival estimate. Authentication is unclear/minimal, relying only on a name/ZIP lookup, and the claim that no further modifications or cancellations can be made is unsupported by shown tool outputs. While it appears to act on the correct account, the missing confirmation and failure to follow the user's priority (cancel if possible) mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
